question: Can a fixed three-step class-owned prototype fitter preserve the scalable relevance selector's Food-101 ranking behavior while removing the repeated scikit-learn KMeans runtime floor?

execution.fold_seed: panel_seed + fold for NOLLOYD, LOOP3, and FUSED3; panel_seed for LP-FULL
execution.normalization: one row-L2 pass owned by each OI method; LP-FULL owns its frozen fold Normalizer
execution.order: deterministic cyclic near-counterbalance over four methods; every method-position count is seven or eight
execution.warmup: one excluded clock-free exact repeat per method on its first frozen panel
execution.checkpoint: one complete paired four-method panel written atomically
execution.resume: identity locked across protocol, code, cache, panel, subset, method, and determinism hashes
execution.runtime: outer wall and CPU clocks include all method-required preprocessing, five folds, fitting, and held-out scoring; cache loading and panel construction are excluded

invariants.looped_fused_numerical_state: centers, owner labels, feature weights, fold scores, and held-out score diagnostics must match exactly on every paired fold
invariants.current_reference_parity: NOLLOYD and LP-FULL scores must exactly match the hash-frozen valid speed_development_v2 rows

statistics.ranking_unit: complete ten-backbone panel at replicate zero and budget 80
statistics.selection_ties: average downstream outcome across selector scores equal within atol=1e-12
statistics.interval: backbone-block percentile 95 percent for runtime; ranking gates use frozen development point contrasts

candidate_gates.clean_linear_vs_probe: candidate minus LP-FULL regret <= 1.0 accuracy point
candidate_gates.nuisance_linear_vs_probe: candidate minus LP-FULL regret <= 1.0 accuracy point
candidate_gates.nonlinear_vs_probe: for quadratic, knn, and rbf on nonlinearity_full, candidate minus LP-FULL regret <= 1.0 point each
candidate_gates.nonlinear_retention: for quadratic, knn, and rbf on nonlinearity_full, candidate minus NOLLOYD regret <= 1.0 point each
candidate_gates.nonlinear_rank_retention: for quadratic, knn, and rbf on nonlinearity_full, candidate Spearman minus NOLLOYD Spearman >= -0.10 each
candidate_gates.runtime_each_arm: median paired candidate/LP-FULL wall ratio <= 1.0 and backbone-bootstrap upper95 <= 1.10

selection_rule.rule: discard any candidate failing a required gate; if one remains select it; if both remain select LOOP3 only when its pooled median wall time is at most 0.95 times FUSED3, otherwise select FUSED3
selection_rule.reason: allow a materially faster simple loop without creating a post-outcome dimension or backbone hybrid

claim_scope: Food-101 retrospective development screen under the archived class-balanced selector sampling protocol. A pass authorizes design of a separately frozen full replay; it is not itself a product or confirmation claim.
